    inclusion_criteria: str

@dataclass

    mechanism: Literal["none", "DP-SGD", "local-DP", "shuffle-DP"]
    epsilon_target: Optional[float]
    delta: Optional[float]
    epsilon_spent_at_round_start: float
    clipping_norm: Optional[float]
    noise_multiplier: Optional[float]
    accountant: Optional[str]

@dataclass
class ThreatModel:
    adversary: list
    secure_aggregation: bool
    min_cohort_size: int
    assumptions: list
    out_of_scope: list

PLACEHOLDER = "<"
def _is_placeholder(v):
    return isinstance(v, str) and v.startswith(PLACEHOLDER)

@dataclass
class FederatedTaskContract:
    round_id: str
    objective: LearningObjective
    population: ParticipantPopulation
    privacy: PrivacyBudget
    threat: ThreatModel

    def validate(self):
        errs = []
        for f in fields(self):
            obj = getattr(self, f.name)
            if _is_placeholder(obj):
                errs.append(f"{f.name} unresolved placeholder")
            if is_dataclass(obj):
                for sub in fields(obj):
                    val = getattr(obj, sub.name)
                    if _is_placeholder(val):
                        errs.append(f"{f.name}.{sub.name} unresolved placeholder")

        if self.objective.target_value is None:
            errs.append("objective.target_value unset")
        if self.objective.task == "other" and not self.objective.model_family:
            errs.append("objective under-specified")

        if len(self.population.client_ids) < self.population.min_clients_per_round:
            errs.append("client pool smaller than min_clients_per_round")
        if not (0 < self.population.sampling_rate <= 1):
            errs.append("sampling_rate must be in (0,1]")
        if len(set(self.population.client_ids)) != len(self.population.client_ids):
            errs.append("duplicate client_ids in population")

        p = self.privacy
        if p.mechanism != "none":
            if p.epsilon_target is None or p.delta is None:
                errs.append("DP claimed but epsilon/delta unset")
            else:
                if p.epsilon_target <= p.epsilon_spent_at_round_start:
                    errs.append("epsilon_target must exceed already-spent epsilon")
                if not (0 < p.delta < 1):
                    errs.append("delta must be in (0,1)")
                if p.clipping_norm is None or p.noise_multiplier is None:
                    errs.append("DP claimed but clipping_norm/noise_multiplier missing")
                if not p.accountant:
                    errs.append("DP claimed but accountant not named")
        elif p.clipping_norm is not None or p.noise_multiplier is not None:
            errs.append("noise params set while mechanism='none'")

        t = self.threat
        if not t.adversary:
            errs.append("threat.adversary empty - no adversary declared")
        if not t.out_of_scope:
            errs.append("threat.out_of_scope empty - must state exclusions")
        if t.secure_aggregation and t.min_cohort_size < 3:
            errs.append("secure aggregation with cohort < 3 is unsafe")
        return errs

    def to_json(self, path=None):
        d = asdict(self)
        if path:
            with open(path, "w") as f:
                json.dump(d, f, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        return json.dumps(d, indent=2, allow_nan=False)

from typing import Optional, Literal
import json

@dataclass
class LearningObjective:
    task: Literal["classification", "regression", "generation", "other"]
    model_family: str
    primary_metric: str
    target_value: Optional[float]
    loss: str

@dataclass
class ParticipantPopulation:
    client_ids: list
    min_clients_per_round: int
    sampling_rate: float
    inclusion_criteria: str
    data_provenance: str

@dataclass
class PrivacyBudget:
    mechanism: Literal["none", "DP-SGD", "local-DP", "shuffle-DP"]
    epsilon_target: Optional[float]
    delta: Optional[float]
    epsilon_spent_at_round_start: float
    clipping_norm: Optional[float]
    noise_multiplier: Optional[float]
    accountant: Optional[str]

@dataclass
class ThreatModel:
    adversary: list
    secure_aggregation: bool
    min_cohort_size: int
    assumptions: list
    out_of_scope: list

PLACEHOLDER = "<"
def _is_placeholder(v):
    return isinstance(v, str) and v.startswith(PLACEHOLDER)

@dataclass
class FederatedTaskContract:
    round_id: str
    objective: LearningObjective
    population: ParticipantPopulation
    privacy: PrivacyBudget
    threat: ThreatModel

    def validate(self):
        errs = []
        for f in fields(self):
            obj = getattr(self, f.name)
            if _is_placeholder(obj):
                errs.append(f"{f.name} unresolved placeholder")
            if is_dataclass(obj):
                for sub in fields(obj):
                    val = getattr(obj, sub.name)
                    if _is_placeholder(val):
                        errs.append(f"{f.name}.{sub.name} unresolved placeholder")

        if self.objective.target_value is None:
            errs.append("objective.target_value unset")
        if self.objective.task == "other" and not self.objective.model_family:
            errs.append("objective under-specified")

        if len(self.population.client_ids) < self.population.min_clients_per_round:
            errs.append("client pool smaller than min_clients_per_round")
        if not (0 < self.population.sampling_rate <= 1):
            errs.append("sampling_rate must be in (0,1]")
        if len(set(self.population.client_ids)) != len(self.population.client_ids):
            errs.append("duplicate client_ids in population")

        p = self.privacy
        if p.mechanism != "none":
            if p.epsilon_target is None or p.delta is None:
                errs.append("DP claimed but epsilon/delta unset")
            else:
                if p.epsilon_target <= p.epsilon_spent_at_round_start:
                    errs.append("epsilon_target must exceed already-spent epsilon")
                if not (0 < p.delta < 1):
                    errs.append("delta must be in (0,1)")
                if p.clipping_norm is None or p.noise_multiplier is None:
                    errs.append("DP claimed but clipping_norm/noise_multiplier missing")
                if not p.accountant:
                    errs.append("DP claimed but accountant not named")
        elif p.clipping_norm is not None or p.noise_multiplier is not None:
            errs.append("noise params set while mechanism='none'")

        if not t.adversary:
            errs.append("threat.adversary empty - no adversary declared")
        if not t.out_of_scope:
            errs.append("threat.out_of_scope empty - must state exclusions")
        if t.secure_aggregation and t.min_cohort_size < 3:
            errs.append("secure aggregation with cohort < 3 is unsafe")
        return errs
